text: Program Introduction Nankai University offers you the opportunity to study a Master's in International Economics and Business at one of China's oldest and most prestigious universities. Being taught entirely in English by fully qualified and experienced teachers. All of the coursework material is provided in English and you will be able to complete your exams and assignments in English. There are core modules of Chinese language as part of the curriculum that will allow you to develop new language skills whilst you study. Teaching Objective The programmes are designed and delivered by top-class professors with international work and study experience and incorporate international business perspectives – while bringing specific detailed focus on the growing Chinese economy. This innovative Master’s programme is designed to provide you with a general training in economics, while enabling specialisation in the areas of international business in relation to China’s economy. Main Courses Panorama of Contemporary China Intermediate Microeconomics Intermediate Econometrics Intermediate Macroeconomics International Business International Economics Company Case Study Chinese Language I Chinese Language II Transnational Investment and Management International Marketing Corporation Finance International Financial Markets China’s Foreign Trade Topics in China’s Economic Growth International Settlement and Financing Intercultural Communication and Management International Economic Laws
